messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging: Canary quality alert (P2) — canary cluster canary-2 running model variant gptx-8b-quant has hallucination_rate = 4.6x baseline over last 5m. Trigger: quality-monitor/online-eval. Dashboard: https://redwood.internal/alerts/1719001234

Maria Chen: seeing first support tickets at 10:04am — customers reporting confidently wrong facts in completions (billing language added that doesn’t exist). Not huge volume yet but clear regression.

Kevin Patel: rolling canary started at 10:02 (15% traffic to canary-2). I pushed quantized build after last perf review. Latency is fine, throughput ok. Quality seems off.

Sam Ortiz: confirmed metric spike in the inference-eval job: hallucination_rate went from 0.7% -> 3.2% on the canary window. Noise at 10:03-10:06.

Priya Kapoor (on-call): marking incident. Assigning immediate mitigation: we need to flip the model-switcher kill-switch and pull traffic off canary. Plan: 1) disable FF model-switcher -> revert to pinned stable model 2) trigger rollback of canary variant 3) smoke checks + customer comm.

Priya Kapoor: tagging @deploy-bot — please start rollback to stable model variant and set canary traffic to 0%.

deploy-bot: Received. Initiating rollback job. Command run: 
```
redwood-deploy rollback --service inference-api --to-tag stable-v1.4.2 --reason "canary hallucination spike"
redwood-route traffic --service inference-api --from canary-2 --to stable --percent 0
```
Estimated time: ~3m. Job id: rb-7890. Logs: https://ci.redwood/internal/rb-7890

Izzy (SRE): draining canary-2 nodes and removing from LB. Also purging KV prefix for prefix-cache (maybe quantized cache mismatch):
```
kubectl cordon node/canary-2-3
kubectl drain node/canary-2-3 --ignore-daemonsets
redis-cli -h cache.prod DEL prefix:gptx-8b-quant:kvcache
```
If anyone sees residual traffic, hit me and I'll BGP-drain.

Kevin Patel: quick note about rollback safety — no schema/db migrations in this deploy, safe to revert. Good call to purge per-model caches.

Maria Chen: smoke prompts during verification — can we run a quick suite? I’ll run the 10 upstream customer prompts from quick-checks.

Sam Ortiz: running checks now (trace ids included):
- TRACE 0a1b: prompt "What is Redwood's billing frequency?" -> canary output: "We bill monthly per seat and prorate..." (hallucinatory)
- TRACE 0a2c: prompt "Summarize account suspension policy" -> canary output added policy line that doesn't exist.

Sam Ortiz: post-rollback running same prompts against stable:
- TRACE 0a1b: stable output corrected: "Billing frequency is monthly for subscription plans" (no extra hallucinatory clauses).
- TRACE 0a2c: stable output matches docs. Looks like rollback fixed the examples I tried.

deploy-bot: Rollback job rb-7890: COMPLETED. canary-2 traffic: 0%. Current stable: inference-api@stable-v1.4.2.

Priya Kapoor: verification checklist:
- run 10 smoke prompts (Maria) -> PASS (9/10, one borderline, investigating)
- monitor quality-metrics for 15m -> ongoing
- support notify affected customers -> Alex
- create incident ticket + postmortem owner -> Priya

Maria Chen: did the 10 quick-checks, one borderline was a paraphrase that could be misinterpreted; I'll capture sample and add to eval set.

Alex (Support): I'll open high-priority support cases for the 5 customers who reported issues and send the templated acknowledgement. Draft message: "Thanks — we observed an unexpected regression in a canary model today and have reverted traffic. We're investigating root cause and will follow up with a timeline." Anyone want to edit? :thumbsup:

Kevin Patel: :thumbsup: looks good. Add link to incident dashboard and include trace ids.

Izzy (SRE): monitoring: latency/err rates stable, CPU on stable nodes normal. Quality-monitor now back to baseline for the last 3 contiguous 1m windows.

Priya Kapoor: handoff: I will own the initial postmortem. Action items assigned:
- Kevin + Sam: collect diffs between quantized and fp16 inference kernels, perf logs, model artifacts.
- Maria: add failing prompts to eval suite + repro.
- Izzy: preserve canary node images and logs (snapshot rb-7890).
- Alex: customer comms and ticket links.

Priya Kapoor: next steps — we will block the quantized variant from rollout until ML and infra validate outputs and run extended evals. Flagging this for ML review in tomorrow's sync.

deploy-bot: Incident ticket created: INC-20260315-42. Postmortem template seeded at https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-20260315-42/postmortem

Maria Chen: THANKS everyone — partial outage averted, customers notified. I'll follow up with the eval examples and a PR request to add regression checks to the canary harness.

Priya Kapoor: handing off to oncall next shift (Izzy) at 14:00 UTC — put any late findings in the incident ticket. Closing this thread but please continue updates in the ticket. :white_check_mark:
